At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is looking for a Senior Escalations Program Manager to own our most complex customer escalations and turn those experiences into durable improvements. Approximately 70% of your time will be spent managing complex customer finance requests, you will coordinate cross-functional resources, lead executive-level communications, and drive rapid, high-quality resolution for high-severity customer issues. The remaining 30% of your time will focus on programs that eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, proactively resolve potential customer billing issues and scale customer-facing processes.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: Digitizing large sectors of the global economy requires creative problem-solving, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to customer success.

title: Assistant Vice President OR Senior Underwriter, Global Agriculture Reinsurance
description:
Skyward Specialty is a rapidly growing specialty Property & Casualty insurance carrier headquartered in Houston, Texas. We deliver tailored solutions across nine specialized underwriting divisions, with a culture grounded in deep technical expertise, decisive underwriting, and long-term broker and client relationships. Our Global Agriculture division underwrites a worldwide portfolio of agriculture reinsurance, partnering with cedants and reinsurance brokers across multiple territories to support food and farm economies through thoughtfully structured treaty solutions.
Position Summary
The Assistant Vice President OR Senior Underwriter, Global Agriculture Reinsurance is a senior technical underwriting role responsible for supporting, expanding, maintaining, and managing Skyward's global portfolio of agriculture reinsurance. The role underwrites and prices new and renewal treaty submissions, shapes portfolio strategy, and represents Skyward in the reinsurance market with brokers and ceding company clients.
This is a high-authority individual-contributor position for a proven (re)insurance professional who is at their best evaluating complex treaty business, forming a defensible technical view of risk, and building durable broker and client relationships. The role can be filled at the Senior Underwriter or Assistant Vice President level depending on the candidate's experience and underwriting authority. It reports to the Head of Global Agriculture and partners closely with Actuarial, Claims, Finance, and Accounting.
Key Responsibilities

• Perform in-depth technical underwriting and analysis of treaty reinsurance business across the global agriculture portfolio, including proportional and non-proportional structures.

• Underwrite and price new and renewal agriculture reinsurance submissions, applying delegated underwriting authority and pricing methodologies appropriate to crop, livestock, and related agricultural risks.

• Review primary policy forms, reinsurance contract wording, and endorsements to confirm coverage intent, terms, and conditions are accurately reflected and aligned with Skyward's risk appetite.

• Evaluate exposure, loss history, accumulation, and program structure to form a clear, defensible technical view of each opportunity.

• Provide support for strategic planning and ongoing management of the global agriculture portfolio, including profitability monitoring, portfolio construction, and renewal strategy.

• Market, develop, and maintain strong broker and ceding-client relationships, representing Skyward in the market and at industry events.

• Monitor market development and explore trends and cycles in agriculture reinsurance, translating those insights into actionable recommendations.

• Partner with Accounting, Finance, Claims, and Actuarial on monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting and on reserving and planning processes.

• Serve as a senior technical resource to analysts and less-experienced team members, contributing to underwriting guidelines, pricing tools, and best practices (AVP level).

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in agricultural economics, finance, risk management, actuarial science, mathematics, or a related field; advanced degree or professional designations (CPCU, ARe, ACAS/FCAS, or similar) a plus.

• Seven or more years of (re)insurance experience, with a meaningful portion in agriculture, treaty reinsurance, or a closely related specialty line; calibrated toward the AVP end for candidates with broader portfolio or market-facing exposure.

• Demonstrated treaty underwriting and pricing experience, including familiarity with proportional and non-proportional structures.

• Working knowledge of agriculture insurance and reinsurance products and the global agriculture risk landscape.

• Strong command of reinsurance contract and policy wording and the ability to identify coverage and structural issues.

• Proficiency with pricing and exposure analysis tools and strong Excel skills;

title: Solutions Consultant (UK)
description:
🚀 Turn your technical expertise into commercial impact.
What if you could combine your technical expertise with the excitement of winning the deal?
We’re looking for an experienced, commercially minded Solutions Consultant to join Huble ’s UK New Business team. This is an opportunity for a technically credible solutions professional who knows how to get under the skin of a customer’s challenges, design the right solution, and confidently take an opportunity from first conversation through to signed contract.
On-target earnings of up to 1.8x base salary, through an uncapped commission structure tied to individual revenue targets.
You won’t be sitting on the sidelines of the sales process. You’ll own your own number, own your opportunities and own the outcome.
Working with HubSpot at the centre of the solution, you’ll lead complex conversations across CRM, integrations, migrations, data, configuration and change management. You’ll run discovery, shape solutions, build proposals and commercials, present to senior stakeholders, negotiate terms and close deals - bringing in our expert consulting teams when deeper technical or delivery input is needed.
And because many of our opportunities come through HubSpot referrals, partner relationships, invitations and competitive RFPs , this isn’t a role built around endless cold outbound. It’s about being credible enough technically, commercially sharp enough to win, and personable enough to become a trusted advisor.
🖇️What you'll be doing
You’ll take ownership of opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, including:

• Running discovery and chemistry meetings to understand business challenges, goals and requirements.

• Designing and articulating HubSpot-led solutions across CRM, integrations, migrations and adjacent technologies.

• Taking the lead on technical conversations and answering architectural questions confidently, without needing a Solutions Architect on every call.

• Demonstrating HubSpot and the wider solution architecture to prospective customers.

• Clearly explaining how solution decisions and changes affect scope, pricing and delivery.

• Responding quickly and intelligently to RFPs and tenders.

• Working closely with our consulting, technology and leadership teams to turn client requirements into accurate quotes and SOWs at pace.

• Managing your pipeline, forecasts and activity with the commercial discipline needed to hit - and exceed - your sales target.

• Building relationships with Huble ’s strategic partners, including HubSpot, Aircall, DealHub, Sinch and Demandbase, to create and win opportunities together.

• Developing opportunities through referrals, existing relationships, partner networks and your own professional network.

👀The kind of person we're looking for
You might currently be a Solution Architect, Senior Solution Architect, Presales Consultant, Solutions Consultant or Solutions Engineer who is ready to take greater commercial ownership.
Perhaps you’ve built your career within a HubSpot, Salesforce or Dynamics partner consultancy and have already developed a strong understanding of how technology, consulting and commercial outcomes come together.
Or you may come from a complex B2B SaaS, CRM or MarTech environment - perhaps RevOps, ABM, intent data, CDP or integration technology - and have the technical credibility and customer-facing experience to move into a broader solutions-selling role.
The important thing is that you're not purely a technical specialist.
You understand that great solutions have to work commercially as well as technically. You’re comfortable owning a number, running a deal, talking about money, negotiating terms and ultimately asking for the business.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

title: Senior Compliance Analyst, Customer Trust
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Analyst, Customer Trust for our SnowTrust GRC team. You will own the full lifecycle of multiple customer-facing and third-party assessments, from defining scope and owning the project plan to driving deliverables across projects with moderate to high business or technical complexity. You will work daily with IT, Business, Procurement, Security, and Compliance teams, and regularly with leadership, to deliver the vendor and customer projects in your portfolio.

AS A SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, CUSTOMER TRUST AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Customer Trust

- Respond to customer due diligence questionnaires and audits about Snowflake's security and compliance obligations.

- Become an expert on Snowflake's control environment, security features, and best practices for customer deployments.

- Serve as a trusted advisor on customer and regulator inquiries about Snowflake's security and compliance obligations and documentation.

- Join sales conversations to explain Snowflake's security and compliance capabilities.

Third-Party Oversight, Governance, and Risk Management

- Conduct security risk assessments of new and existing vendors, evaluating their security posture against contractual, regulatory, and industry requirements.

- Partner with Legal and Procurement to make sure security requirements are reflected in vendor contracts and security agreements.

- Continuously improve the TPRM program by refining tiering criteria, streamlining intake, and shortening assessment turnaround times.

- Monitor the vendor risk landscape for emerging threats and proactively reassess affected vendors.

- Support customer and regulator inquiries about Snowflake's own third-party risk management practices as part of broader audit engagements.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, CUSTOMER TRUST WILL HAVE:

- 5+ years of technical audit or compliance experience with programs such as SOC 2, ISO certifications, PCI DSS, C5, Cyber Essentials Plus, or IT audits based on ISAE 3402 preferred.

- Experience in vendor risk management, third-party risk, procurement security, or a related GRC function.

- A detailed understanding of evaluating the design and effectiveness of IT controls, collecting evidence, and working with auditors and regulators on these assessments.

- Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent vendor assessments while keeping turnaround times consistent.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain compliance concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience using AI to automate or streamline manual compliance workflows.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

title: Senior Compute Infrastructure Engineer
description:
• About StackYak

StackYak is building the infrastructure layer for AI.
We are an early-stage, funded company building software that brings compute, GPU infrastructure, networking, and inference together into one product. The opportunity is large, the market is moving quickly, and we are building for real production workloads from the start.
This is not internal IT. This is not a slow-moving infrastructure team maintaining someone else's platform. The infrastructure is the product .
We are a small, senior team with very little bureaucracy. This is a founding role in its discipline. You will be the first person here whose primary responsibility is the systems layer beneath the product, and the shape it takes will largely be yours to decide.
Treat this document as a starting point rather than a boundary. The people who do well here take ground early and are not asked to give it back.
We move quickly. We do not have months for someone to learn the fundamentals of their discipline. You should already be very good at what you do, be able to ramp into adjacent areas quickly, and be comfortable operating without perfect requirements or neatly defined boundaries.
The Role
We need someone who knows what stands between GPU capacity and production infrastructure , and can build it.
That capacity does not arrive in one form. Some of it comes as hardware, with everything that implies: firmware, drivers, hosts, and physical work carried out by people you will never meet in buildings you will rarely visit. Some of it comes from neoclouds and other providers, where you control the software and very little else, on terms set by someone whose interests are not yours.
The interesting problem is neither of those on its own. It is the gap between them - how much of it can honestly be abstracted away, how much has to stay visible, and how much the rest of the company should ever have to think about. Those are open questions here, and the person in this role is the one who gets to answer them.
You should be comfortable at both ends. On one side: Linux, kernel, firmware, drivers, virtualization, host hardening, and debugging a machine you cannot walk up to. On the other: provider APIs, capacity that is not permanent, and automation at a scale where nothing gets configured by hand.
Workloads will run on bare metal, in VMs, and in containers. The right answer will not be the same one twice, and choosing is part of the job.
This is not an architecture-only role. You will design systems and then build, debug, and operate them.
What You Will Own
Not tasks. Outcomes, and the authority that comes with them.

• What the fleet is. What we own versus what we rent, where we standardise and where we deliberately do not, and what it costs us either way.

• The machines themselves. Linux, kernel, firmware, drivers, CUDA and/or ROCm - down to the layer where the answer lives in a changelog rather than documentation.

• Bare metal, VM, or container. You own the boundary between them, and the uncomfortable fact that the right answer will not be the same one twice.

• Isolation. What we claim about keeping customers and workloads apart, and whether that claim survives someone attacking it.

• Provisioning and recovery. A machine goes from nothing to serving, and from broken back to serving, without you personally being involved.

• Provider integration. Neoclouds and other compute vendors: what each of them actually gives you as opposed to what they advertise, and the seams that difference creates.

• Physical reality. Specifying hardware, and getting it from a purchase order to a booting machine through vendors, data-center partners, and remote hands you have never met.

• Failures that cross layers , where the cause could be hardware, firmware, OS, virtualization, storage, or network, and nobody else wants to own the question.

• Making it operable by other people , so the fleet does not quietly become a collection of one-off machines only you understand.

title: Temporary Staff Accountant (Contract / Project-Based)
description:
Category: Financial Services

Location:

Atlas Advisors LLC is seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Temporary Staff Accountant to assist our CFO with a specific, project-based accounting cleanup. Our current processes involve significant manual work and complex historical details. This role is strictly project-based and will conclude once the accounting backlog is fully resolved.

This is a junior-level role best suited for someone who is eager to dig into transactional details, untangle manual data, and support fundamental accounting tasks. The ideal candidate must have a solid grasp of basic P&L and Balance Sheet principles and a strong willingness to roll up their sleeves to solve operational backlogs.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Backlog & Reconciliations

• Assist the CFO in reviewing, matching, and reconciling historical general ledger accounts, focusing on Balance Sheet and P&L line items.

• Research transactional discrepancies, missing documentation, and un-reconciled balances across manual spreadsheets and system logs.

• Perform routine subledger-to-general ledger reconciliations (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bank accounts).

• Key in, organize, and clean up historical accounting entries to bring financial records up to date.

General Accounting Operations

• Support daily transactional processing as needed to keep current operations moving while clearing the backlog.

• Enter, verify, and code vendor invoices, expense reports, and customer billing data.

• Maintain organized digital audit trails and electronic filing for all reconciled transactions.

• Gather supporting documentation for financial schedules and routine reporting as directed by the CFO.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

• Detail-Oriented & Hands-On: Absolute willingness to dive deep into granular transactional details, troubleshoot manual process errors, and work through complex spreadsheets.

• Core Accounting Fundamentals: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, general ledger structures, and how transactions impact the P&L and Balance Sheet.

• Software & Excel Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, basic pivot tables, data sorting/filtering, and formula building).

• Work Ethic & Focus: Ability to follow direction closely, work independently on repetitive or detailed tasks, and ask clarifying questions when encountering anomalies.

• Role Understanding: Clear understanding that this is a temporary, contract-based position that will end when the backlog project is complete.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience.

• Software Experience: Prior experience with Deltek Costpoint is strongly preferred (experience with Unanet or other ERP systems is also a plus).

• Industry Background: Previous exposure to government contracting environments is preferred, but not required.

• Education: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or coursework toward a degree (relevant practical experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

​

Work Type
This is a temporary, project-based 1099 contract position. The contractor is guaranteed 20 hours per week, with the potential to scale up to 40 hours per week based on accounting backlog volume and business needs. This position is fully remote and will conclude once the accounting backlog has been resolved.

description:
OVERVIEW
Fractured Atlas is seeking two full‐time Member Advisors - one Grants & Member Advisor and one Fundraising & Member Advisor. Fractured Atlas is a national, fully remote nonprofit arts service organization. Our work is guided by the belief that some of the boldest, most urgent creative work happens outside of institutions, led by individual artists, emerging collectives, and grassroots organizations. Our mission is to make the journey from inspiration to living practice more accessible and equitable for artists and creatives. We run the largest fiscal sponsorship program in the country, supporting thousands of active projects in every creative medium across all 50 states. Through fundraising tools, educational resources, visa letters, community programming, and 1-on-1 support, we help artists access the funding, time, and community they need to make the art the world needs.
A successful candidate in both roles will be a creative problem solver and quick learner who has an enthusiasm for the arts, is incredibly personable over the phone and email, possesses a high level of patience and understanding (particularly as it relates to explaining the same information multiple times), and is able to operate and respond in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm and collected. The Grants & Member Advisor will have expertise around supporting our fiscally sponsored projects through the grant process from application through reporting. The Fundraising & Member Advisor will have expertise around advising our fiscally sponsored projects on fundraising and donation processes, including individual appeals, crowdfunding, giving day campaigns, donation policies and processes, and donation investigation.
Candidates with a work history that includes grant writing, fundraising, development, and/or customer service will likely excel. Since Fractured Atlas works virtually, these positions require strong self-motivation and both will be remotely supervised by the Associate Director of Education & Engagement.
At Fractured Atlas , we individually and collectively work hard to carry out our organization’s mission. We also understand that work is just one part of life and, through a culture of care, support team members having full and robust lives outside of work. With that foundation, our organizational culture embraces people who are open to:

• Building trust with others and addressing equitable distribution of responsibilities when collaborating.

• Learning new ways of working while welcoming change as a way to reshape processes/policies/programming that no longer serve our values.

• Transparency in communications, decision making, and feedback.

• Centering care and connection in our individual work and in relation to our colleagues.

We recognize that the culture and core values of an organization should continue to evolve to reflect the world we live in. At any given time, we recognize that there might be emerging values other than ourstated values and we continue to have conversations about stated and emerging values.
Additionally, at Fractured Atlas we work to adhere toanti-racism and anti-oppression principlesin all areas of our internal and external work. This commitment is grounded in our belief that change is possible, and that our work and that of the artistic community as a whole will grow stronger as oppression is eliminated.
In our current phase of this journey towards being an Anti-Racist Anti-Oppressive organization, the whole staff is engaged in all staff ARAO meetings led by rotating teams and undergo training as part of their onboarding process. We recognize that we do not have all of the answers as we pursue this work. This work will continue to shift as the Fractured Atlas team changes. We ask that new team members join us as we continue to learn, practice, and grow in this work. Learn more about what it’s like to work at Fractured Atlas here.

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. We are looking for a first-class Legal Practice Assistant to provide white glove support service to our firm’s partners and attorneys. The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. title: Security Engineer, Kubernetes
locationText: Palo Alto, CA; Austin, TX; New York, NY; Washington, DC
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We protect the platform that runs X and SpaceXSI. We don’t just report issues, we actively look for real risks and exploits in our Kubernetes environments and turn them into durable fixes and tooling. You will secure the platform behind X and SpaceXSI’s infrastructure, products, and workloads. If you know pod and platform security, think in attack paths, and want to build the defenses that make the platform safer at scale, we want to hear from you.

We Value

• Understanding how Kubernetes can actually be abused, not only how it is configured

• Shipping practical controls and tooling over writing policy documents

• Least privilege and defense-in-depth at fleet scale

• Clear findings and fixes that platform teams can act on

• Safe, constrained validation that does not put production at risk

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Secure the platform end to end: nodes, clusters, pods, roles, tokens, secrets, service-to-service communication, and the supply chain

• Find and remediate overprivileged permissions, dangerous pod and workload settings, and escalation paths in operators, admission, networking, identity, and monitoring

• Assess our own platform the way an adversary would, including container and pod breakout, privilege escalation, and movement across workloads, using safe and constrained validation, then fix what you find

• Design and build security tooling and automation, including AI-assisted analysis, that catches risky configuration and overprivilege before or after it ships

• Strengthen identity and secrets handling so workloads receive only the access they need

• Improve supply-chain security through secure base images, continuous scanning, and related controls

• Review changes that affect RBAC, operators, ServiceAccounts, network policies, and anything running with elevated privileges

• Partner with platform and product teams as a security owner, taking problems from identification through rollout

• Contribute to fleet-wide hardening, policy enforcement, and safer defaults

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years in platform security, Kubernetes security, or offensive security against production infrastructure

• Deep knowledge of pod and workload security: privileged containers, capabilities, host namespaces, host path mounts, service accounts, RBAC, admission control, and network isolation

• Working knowledge of identity, secrets, workload identity, service-to-service trust, supply chain, runtime, and cloud access

• Able to think like an attacker, measure blast radius, and turn the path into a detection, control, or tool

• Comfortable with operators, custom resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows

• Able to build or modify security tooling in Go, Python, or Rust when a control needs automation

• Bonus: Image scanning, SBOMs, secure base images, policy-as-code (Kyverno, OPA), multi-cluster environments, runtime detection, and security testing of customer-facing application

• Open to working out of one of our offices: Palo Alto, Austin, DC, or New York. 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience developing AI-driven security tools or integrating AI into security workflows

• Familiarity with Kubernet

Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 As a software engineer on Benchling's Infrastructure team, you will design, build, and operate the platforms, services, and tooling that let every Benchling engineering team ship and run software reliably, securely, and cost-effectively. Our work spans the foundations of our AWS environment: compute (Kubernetes/EKS), networking, secrets and identity, observability, infrastructure-as-code, and the economics of running all of it at scale.

We hire software engineers for this team because strong programming, systems design, and problem-solving skills are the most durable foundation for infrastructure impact. You will independently scope and own meaningful, multi-quarter pieces of our platform end to end, from an ambiguous starting point to a production rollout and operational handoff, building paved roads that make the secure, reliable, and efficient path the default for engineers across Benchling.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own projects end-to-end, from initial design and tech plan, to prototype, to production rollout and operational handoff.

- Design, build, and maintain internal applications, APIs, automation, and tooling (CLIs, Slack apps, serverless services, and AI-powered assistants) that support Benchling's cloud platform and infrastructure workflows.

- Own parts of our AWS foundation, including Kubernetes (EKS), networking, secrets and PKI, and the security and observability capabilities around them, with clear SLOs, runbooks, and actionable telemetry.

- Advance our infrastructure-as-code practices at scale: operate and improve our Terraform Cloud release system, reusable Terraform modules, and the tooling around them, with policy-as-code guardrails that let service teams self-serve safely.

- Drive cloud cost governance as an engineering discipline: build cost visibility and anomaly alerting, allocate shared platform costs to the services that drive them, analyze usage trends.

- Contribute to observability tooling, vendor relationships, and the cost and performance tradeoffs of our monitoring stack.

- Make architectural decisions that other teams build on, drive alignment across multiple teams, and help set technical direction and standards for the areas you own.

- Operate and improve production systems, including on-call, incident response, blameless postmortems, and root-cause analysis, and use what you learn to reduce toil.

- Partner with engineers across Benchling to understand internal customer needs, mentor teammates through design reviews and tech plan feedback, and help mature our tooling, best practices, and engineering processes.

Check out our engineering blog https://benchling.engineering/ for examples of past work.

- How We Run Terra

title: Solutions and Tool Specialist – Functional Safety
description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.
Solutions and Tool Specialist - Functional Safety
About the Role
Safety-critical semiconductor products are growing across every market ADI serves. The Functional Safety Office (FSO) is a global team responsible for independent safety confirmation at the highest integrity levels per ISO 26262, and the tooling and infrastructure that supports that work needs to scale with the portfolio.
This role puts you at the center of that challenge. You will build reusable analysis infrastructure - starting with Medini Analyze component libraries - support the development of training content, and work across multiple product families and design types rather than being embedded in a single program. You will gain broad cross-portfolio exposure to how safety-critical semiconductor products are developed.
This role offers a structured path into functional safety - with mentoring from experienced Safety Specialists, progressive project exposure, and the opportunity to build the tooling infrastructure that shapes how safety engineering scales across ADI. You are not expected to arrive as a functional safety expert. You are expected to arrive as an engineer with a solid foundation in semiconductor product development or quality engineering who wants to build tools, tool interfaces, reusable assets and workflows that improve engineering execution.
Why This Team
The FSO operates as ADI's independent safety authority, working across business units and product families rather than within a single design group. The team is global and high-impact - the tooling and methods you help build here will be used across every safety-critical product ADI ships. You will gain exposure to a breadth of product architectures and safety challenges that few individual contributor roles in the industry offer.
Job Responsibilities:
Support, develop and maintain reusable component libraries in Medini Analyze for safety analysis (FMEDA, FTA, dependent failure analysis) across ADI product families, working alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists to ensure technical accuracy and standards compliance.
Work with the FSO team and BU teams to standardize analysis templates and modeling patterns, and translate product-family-specific safety architectures into reusable, parameterized components that improve consistency and reduce setup time for new assessments.
Support the development of role-based training content for common safety activities including FMEDA execution, safety case construction, and safety requirements writing.
Engage with tool vendors such as Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) on capability evaluation, feature requests, and user community activities.
Develop functional safety domain expertise through structured mentoring and progressive project exposure, contributing to confirmation reviews and safety assessments as competence develops.
Who You Will Work With:
Day-to-day: You will work alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists around the world, who provide technical direction and mentoring on safety analysis and Medini.
Across the FSO: You will collaborate with Functional Safety Managers and Safety Specialists globally to understand where enablement assets have the highest impact.
Engineering teams: You will work with Design Engineers across business units who are the consumers of the tools, templates, and training content you help build.
Tool vendors: You will participate in vendor engagements with Synops

ÜBER COSUNO

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

DIE ROLLE

Du ownst jeden Kunden nach erfolgreichem Onboarding Abschluss: Performance Tracking, Erstkontakt nach Kündigungseingang innerhalb von fünf Werktagen, Pain-Analyse, Angebot, Abschluss oder sauberer Abschied. Du verhandelst Paketwechsel, Laufzeiten und Incentives selbstständig innerhalb des Playbooks und hältst den Preis, wo er zu halten ist.

Dein Erfolg bemisst sich am Wert deines Kundenpools: Winbacks, Downgrades, Upsells - was am Ende an ARR bleibt. Dafür forecastest du deine Cases wöchentlich mit Commit und Best Case und hältst Salesforce so sauber, dass dein Forecast ohne Nachfrage lesbar ist.

Rund 30 % deiner Zeit onboardest du Neukunden, die ohne Hilfe nicht in die Nutzung kommen: Onboarding-Call, Profil, erste Angebote.

Du berichtest an den Head of Customer Success.

WORAN WIR DICH NACH 12 MONATEN MESSEN

- Mindestens 50 % der Kündigungen, die du bearbeitest, hast du (zu einem Upsell) gedreht.

- Du bearbeitest alle Winback Cases im Monat, jeder Kunde hat innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von dir gehört und ein konkretes Angebot bekommen.

- Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, Commit und Best Case, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

- Salesforce ist bei dir vollständig: Status, Kündigungsgrund, Angebot, Ergebnis - bei jedem Case.

WER BEI COSUNO ERFOLGREICH IST

- Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

- Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

- Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, telefonierst du mehr, nicht weniger.

- Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

DIESE ROLLE IST FÜR DICH, WENN

- du 30 Kundengespräche die Woche normal findest und nach dem dritten Nichterreichen zum vierten Mal anrufst - unsere Kunden stehen auf der Baustelle.

- du ein Nein aushältst und lieber das Angebot umbaust, als den Preis zu senken.

- du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast.

- du Handwerksbetriebe magst und ihre Sprache sprichst.

DIESE ROLLE IST NICHTS FÜR DICH, WENN

- du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest.

- du aus Support oder Service kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest.

- du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und wöchentliche Cases als Fließband empfindest.

- dich eine Zahl über deinem Schreibtisch stresst statt motiviert.

HARTE ANFORDERUNGEN

- 2-4 Jahre in einer quotentragenden Rolle: Inside Sales, SDR/BDR mit Closing-Anteil, Renewals, Retention oder Account Management im SMB-Geschäft.

- Belegbare Zielerreichung in den letzten Perioden.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2), Englisch gut.

About the Company
We are building the standard for how regulated blockchain applications enforce transaction rules at the smart contract layer. We empower teams to create modular, programmable policies such as AML/CFT checks or offchain collateral requirements that are verified before a transaction executes onchain. Our system enforces these policies with cryptographic guarantees, providing robust, scalable risk management tailored to real-world use cases.
About the Role
As Protocol Lead, you will own the design, development, and maintenance of our onchain suite. You will build tooling to support integrations, contribute to core infrastructure, and research emerging technologies to keep us at the forefront of the industry. You will also serve as the team's blockchain subject matter expert, supporting teammates across the stack on all things related to blockchain interactions.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the architecture, development, and maintenance of our core smart contracts

• Support customers integrating at the smart contract level

• Deeply understand and add support for non-EVM chains

• Iterate on the SDK and relevant documentation to supply a strong integration experience

• Collaborate with the rest of the engineering team in Go and TypeScript on blockchain-facing technology

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering

• 2+ years of experience in Solidity development

• Deep familiarity with Solidity, Rust, and other relevant emerging tools

• Strong familiarity with Golang and/or TypeScript

• Strong communication skills and comfort working with external partners and customers

• Curiosity, initiative, and a drive to ship high-quality systems

Benefits

• Unlimited PTO with a high level of autonomy

• Best-in-class health, dental, and vision insurance

- Bi-annual worldwide team offsites

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
description:
Job Description
Job Description:
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek -- so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
Taking the lead to manage the negotiation and business relationships development with external Service Supplier companies you build effective and profitable agreements transforming broad concepts into structured Strategic Services Suppliers Management Program.
You are a key player to contribute to the solution design of local/multi-national and multi-partner projects involving Agilent partnership with Service Supplier companies for complex, high impact client agreements.
Furthermore, you will support the program managers to provide consistent and up to date program processes, documentation, trainings, contracts & exhibits in assigned territory for Strategic Service Sourcing, ASP-Management.

Your key responsibilities:

• Accountable for managing and maintaining Service Providers and Service Contractors business

relationships

• Ensure full legal compliance and alignment with Region, Sub Region or Country agreed strategy.

• Analyze suppliers' performance and conduct regular suppliers' evaluation reviews, involving Service

Management as required.

• Conduct Service Supplier selection and negotiations to assure best Service Level Agreement and

financial margin improvements.

• Contribute to develop suppliers sourcing strategy, priorities, plans for the defined Sub-Region or

countries.

• Implement service sourcing strategy to ensure an effective, coherent & consistent service suppliers'

program.

• Management of service suppliers program processes, documentation, data, contracts & exhibits in

assigned territory.

• Work closely with Regional and Country legal/compliance teams, act as local contact to ensure the
Service Suppliers working legal/compliance practices are up to date, communicated and in place.

• Contribute to competitive Supplier tender events at all levels of complexity, work with Service Sales
and Project Managers, maintain service providers' services/products/prices data.

• Work closely with Customer Contact Center to assure the Service Suppliers information is available

to manage customers' calls.

• Ensure good co-operation and collaboration with Service Managers.

The role will involve up to 25 % travelling.
Qualifications
We are looking for an engaging individual with a real passion for customer satisfaction and the following:

• Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.

• Typically, at least 6+ years relevant experience for entry to this level.

• Experience in procurement / supplier management is plus

- Fluency in English and local language

• On a personal level, you are a customer focused, solution oriented and business savvy. You also
have great communications skills to interact with a lot of stakeholder and are able to multitask to
work with different projects concurrently.

Additional Details
This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
